selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the method-type anchor because the retry must replace an unsupported proxy-to-later-outcome claim with a directly certifiable object on one locked task. Reframe_as_solvable_object closes it by defining paper-core responsibility as the smallest source-anchored procedural subset whose paired net effect is equivalent to the complete artifact within a preregistered margin, rather than treating subset search itself as the contribution.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This sibling shares the anchor's effect-preservation certificate: the full PaperToSkill artifact is the costly reference object and the certified procedural slice is its runnable substitute on the same task. Architectural_operator_substitution closes the gap by requiring a simultaneous paired effect-gap bound, contract validity, guardrail noninferiority, and measured cost reduction before the smaller slice can replace the complete artifact.

deliverable_coverage: method - the anchor gap's reframe_as_solvable_object leg yields the runnable EffectSlice compiler and its source-grounded effect-preservation certificate; the sibling substitution leg executes the certified slice.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether tasks derived from the paper or skill, or selected by a fixed reproduction benchmark, are representative enough of the user's target-task distribution to support an adoption decision.
deferred_gaps.reason: Out of scope: EffectSlice certifies one locked task and makes no claim that this task represents any broader distribution.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier quantifies decision calibration across paper families, user tasks, agent models, environments, and probe budgets, including false-adoption and false-rejection rates.
deferred_gaps.reason: Out of scope: certificates are task-local and paper-local, with no cross-paper prediction, ranking, or effect transport.
